chronology: Used-source documentary development. V4 codebook, questionnaire, crosswalk and incidental printed summaries already inspected; no participant dataset acquired, no field projection or empirical calculation in this preparation.

catalog.route: Only actual producer-provided UI ASCII package link for V4 dataset 1; no guessed download endpoint or signed-link persistence.

access_and_terms.basis: Root ordinary browser-rendered terms inspection, not reviewer HTTP terms verification. Public catalog/document access does not prove dataset availability, no login, or redistribution permission.
access_and_terms.binding_action_prerequisite: Actual human confirmation immediately before agreeing to binding ICPSR terms. This protocol and its review are not that confirmation.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Known terms prohibit redistribution of data or other materials absent agreement except stated exceptions. Original archive and instruments remain ignored local material; no GitHub/source archive publication.
unresolved: Actual binding action and whether acceptance itself starts delivery
Actual anonymous/login/institution requirements and permitted local use under applicable terms
Actual package identity and format before delivery

requires_before_action: Independent review of a finite committed acquisition-only protocol
Actual human confirmation at the binding terms action
Root explicit selection recorded before any action that may start delivery, including Agree if it initiates delivery
eventual_acquisition_scope.request_meaning: One explicit producer-provided transfer-initiating browser action, not a guarantee about browser-internal network requests or redirects. Preparatory navigation is not participant-package delivery.
eventual_acquisition_scope.route: Displayed normal producer V4 dataset 1 ASCII route only. Stop on any new login/account/access challenge; no guessed endpoint, mirror or source repair.
eventual_acquisition_scope.format_expected: Producer-labelled ASCII package; ZIP format and members remain unverified before delivery.
eventual_acquisition_scope.destination: Fresh exclusive ignored attempt directory selected and verified by root; do not overwrite original bytes. Browser-supplied completed file may be copied verbatim into that directory.
operations_allowed: Retain supplied original bytes privately, hash and measure them without inspecting content
Record only actually observed browser completion/local capture times, status and origin/path; unavailable observations are null
Read only ZIP central-directory and end-directory metadata, including declared member names/type labels/compression/sizes/CRC; inspect no local header or member body
operations_forbidden: Open/read/decompress/extract any archive member, including setup or documentation members
Run ZipFile.testzip or verify member CRC/body integrity by decompression
Project/classify/link/decode participant fields or calculate statistics
Publish private member names/paths, raw exceptions, original archive or instruments
Add clinical parameters/fit, connect engine or open scientific gates

software_resource_policy.meaning: Software review/admission limits only. Browser-managed download has no promised live streaming cap or cancellation capability. Apply archive-byte cap after browser delivery; preserve completed oversized originals privately, stop without further archive review or retry. Declared size/count limits are central-directory claims, not verified body sizes.
software_resource_policy.partial_download_policy: Preserve partial original bytes only when the supported browser API makes them available. Otherwise record unavailable/null, never claim partial preservation or download completeness.
metadata_refusals: Declared encryption flag or unsupported compression method
Declared count/size limit exceeded or central metadata inconsistent
Duplicate declared member names or unsafe absolute/traversal/symlink path metadata
software_resource_policy.refusal_scope: These are refusals based only on available directory metadata. Absence of an encryption flag or duplicate in that directory is not proof about local headers or member bodies. No extraction occurs even for safe-looking names.

private_receipt_schema.unknown_observations: Null. A browser completion signal/local capture does not establish network-level completeness. Central-directory parsing alone does not establish transport_complete.
private_receipt_schema.member_type_scope: Name/extension label only, not verified content.
private_receipt_schema.signed_queries: Never persist transient signed query tokens; public landing and actual observed origin/path only.

failure_policy: Retain any supported completed or available partial original bytes and a private honest receipt; fixed sanitized public unavailable status if needed. No automatic retry, raw exception/member/path dump, guessed mirror or source repair. Unavailable transport observations remain null.
separate_future_field_contract_required: Native format-specific missing encodings and exact selected columns
Private key semantics and complete wave linkage/disposition
Derived diagnosis names/question pointers and conflicting thresholds/operators
Wave-specific fasting grammar and specimen alignment
Measurement/death/last-contact clocks and event ordering or explicitly unknown clocks
Selection/population transport, weights and observation likelihood
Pre-value disclosure/privacy rules plus independently admitted parser code
review_boundary: Finite acquisition-only protocol. It does not accept terms or authorize execution by itself. Independent review, actual human terms confirmation and recorded root selection precede any transfer-initiating action. No participant intake or clinical observation contract; no own future commit/hash or recursive review seal.
